generic.title: Chinese Dialect Atlas
generic.description: Explore dialect phonology, lexical resources, and geographic patterns.

menuEntry.title: Feature Navigation
menuEntry.description: Open query, comparison, map, phonology, corpus, village, and tool entries.

menuAboutIntro.title: About Chinese Dialect Atlas
menuAboutIntro.description: View the site's feature introduction, development history, and more.

menuAboutSuggestion.title: Feedback Entry
menuAboutSuggestion.description: Open GitHub or Zhihu to file an issue, or submit feedback directly on this site.

menuAboutLike.title: Support
menuAboutLike.description: View the project repository, related Zhihu articles, and the author's development insights.

menuQueryZhonggu.title: Middle Chinese Query
menuQueryZhonggu.description: Rime Book → Readings · Organize readings by rime-book category, separated into initials, finals, and tones

menuQueryChar.title: Character Query
menuQueryChar.description: View character readings, Middle Chinese categories, and annotations

menuQueryYinwei.title: Phoneme Query
menuQueryYinwei.description: Readings → Rime Book · Analyze which rime-book category each initial, final, and tone reading comes from

menuQueryTone.title: Tone Query
menuQueryTone.description: View tone classes and tone values across locations

menuMapView.title: Map View
menuMapView.description: Geo-linguistic visualization: view query and comparison results on the map, and draw syllable isogloss maps, heatmaps, and more.

menuMapDivide.title: Map Regions
menuMapDivide.description: Look up the region each dialect location belongs to, and jump to the map to draw it.

menuMapCustom.title: Personal Map Data
menuMapCustom.description: View and manage custom dialect data and plot it on the map. Bound to your account and synced across devices.

menuCompareChar.title: Character Comparison
menuCompareChar.description: Compare how the same character is pronounced across locations.

menuCompareZhonggu.title: Middle Chinese Comparison
menuCompareZhonggu.description: Compare how the same Middle Chinese position develops across locations.

menuCompareTone.title: Tone Comparison
menuCompareTone.description: Compare whether two tone classes merge or stay distinct across locations.

menuComparePhonetic.title: Phonology Comparison
menuComparePhonetic.description: Compare the phonetic value correspondence of the selected locations (2 to 5 locations).

menuResult.title: Results
menuResult.description: Result pages for character, Middle Chinese, phoneme, and tone queries.

menuPhoMatrix.title: Phonology Query
menuPhoMatrix.description: View the full phonology table and homophone lexicon for a dialect location, presented as a grid of initial–final–tone combinations.

menuPhoCustom.title: Phoneme Classification
menuPhoCustom.description: Classify a dialect location's initials, finals, and tones by rhyme-book category features.

menuPhoCount.title: Syllable Statistics
menuPhoCount.description: Count syllables for a dialect location and render charts and isogloss maps, with separate modes for initials/finals/tones, toneless syllables, and toned syllables.

menuPhoEvolution.title: Evolution
menuPhoEvolution.description: Trace a dialect location's current phonology against rhyme-book categories, visualizing the historical evolution of initials, finals, and tones with pie and Sankey charts.

menuSettings.title: Settings
menuSettings.description: Configure language, theme, query input mode, tutorial toggles, and more.

menuSource.title: Sources
menuSource.description: View the character-table sources, references, and administrative divisions behind the dialect data.

menuPrivacy.title: Privacy
menuPrivacy.description: Learn about this site's privacy policy and citation notes.

menuTools.title: Tools
menuTools.description: Entries for character-table checking and merging, Jyutping conversion, the online Praat tool, GIS drawing tools, and more.

menuVocabularyView.title: Vocabulary Browser
menuVocabularyView.description: Browse and search all collaborator-submitted vocabulary data, with card, map, and table views.

menuVocabularyImport.title: Vocabulary Import
menuVocabularyImport.description: Upload new vocabulary data. Request access first, fill in location information, then submit the vocabulary in the standard format.

menuVocabularyManage.title: Vocabulary Management
menuVocabularyManage.description: Manage uploaded vocabulary with online editing, bulk replacement, and adding or removing entries.

menuYubao.title: Language Protection Data
menuYubao.description: Query Language Protection Project vocabulary (1000 words) and grammar sentences (50 sentences), with map, card, and table views.

menuVillages.title: Village Entry
menuVillages.description: Open the natural-village tree, tables, and machine-learning analysis tools.

menuCluster.title: Dialect Clustering
menuCluster.description: Explore clustering relationships between dialect locations by dialect feature data.

exploreEntry.title: Explore Navigation
exploreEntry.description: Open tools, character tables, village data, and topic pages.

exploreCheck.title: Character Table Check
exploreCheck.description: Upload a dialect character-table file to automatically flag common issues such as non-single characters, abnormal transcriptions, and missing tones, with online editing to fix them.

exploreJyut2Ipa.title: Jyutping to IPA
exploreJyut2Ipa.description: Batch-convert Jyutping in Excel spreadsheets into IPA, with custom rule configuration.

exploreMerge.title: Character Table Merge
exploreMerge.description: Upload a reference table and the table to merge; characters are aligned and merged in the reference table's order.

exploreDerive.title: Phonology Derivation
exploreDerive.description: Assist in deriving and generating character tables.

explorePraat.title: Praat Acoustic Analysis
explorePraat.description: Upload audio or record directly to inspect acoustic results (fundamental frequency, formants, spectrogram, vowel space, and more), with automatic tone-chart generation via the Shi Feng T-value method.

exploreGis.title: Map Drawing
exploreGis.description: An online GIS map editor for adding, editing, and deleting geographic features, with Thiessen-polygon auto-generation of dialect distribution maps.

exploreManage.title: Data Management
exploreManage.description: Manage and maintain the site database.

exploreCharClass.title: Character Set
exploreCharClass.description: Expand characters level by level by rhyme-book category, view the characters and notes in each category, and customize the order.

exploreYcOverview.title: Yangchun Topic
exploreYcOverview.description: View an overview of Yangchun dialect resources.

exploreYcWords.title: Yangchun Words
exploreYcWords.description: Browse Yangchun dialect words and example sentences.

exploreYcExpressions.title: Yangchun Expressions
exploreYcExpressions.description: Browse Yangchun dialect expressions and grammar data.

exploreYcVillages.title: Yangchun Villages
exploreYcVillages.description: View Yangchun village data and distribution.

exploreVillagesToponyms.title: Toponym Search
exploreVillagesToponyms.description: Search village place names and administrative information.

exploreVillagesGd.title: Guangdong Village Tree
exploreVillagesGd.description: Browse Guangdong village data by administrative hierarchy, with tree expansion and dialect-map visualization.

exploreVillagesTable.title: Guangdong Village Table
exploreVillagesTable.description: Browse and query Guangdong village data in a table, with sorting, filtering, and pagination.

exploreVillagesMl.title: Village Machine Learning
exploreVillagesMl.description: Analyze the patterns and regularities of village names using machine learning.

exploreVillagesAll.title: All Villages
exploreVillagesAll.description: Browse the village records collected by the site.

villagesML.title: Village Analysis Workspace
villagesML.description: Analyze the character, semantic, spatial, and clustering features of villages.

auth.title: Account
auth.description: Sign in, register, or view account information, leaderboards, and more.

authData.title: Personal Data
authData.description: View and manage dialect data you have added.

authRegions.title: Personal Regions
authRegions.description: Manage custom dialect regions saved to your account.
